items.t: Lower steering shaft joint may separate (recall)
Driver airbag may go off unexpectedly (recall)
Clicking steering wheel, airbag light and dead wheel buttons
items.note: Check for an open campaign first; the dealer may cover it.

items.t: Front passenger airbag may not inflate (recall)
Driver-side curtain airbag may not inflate (recall)
Right rear seat belt anchor may come loose (recall)
items.job: Weld retaining plate and install new anchor bolt (recall)

items.t: Backup camera picture can disappear (recall)
Jerky or hesitant shifts at low speed
items.job: Software update and clutch adaptation; replace dual clutch if worn
items.note: Low end is a software update and relearn; high end is a dual clutch replacement, which needs the transmission removed.

items.t: Timing chain rattle on cold start
items.job: Replace timing chain, tensioner and guides
items.note: If only the tensioner is replaced, cost is much lower.

items.t: Coolant leak or thermostat failure
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $1,230-$1,630 for a QX30 thermostat replacement.

items.t: Oil leak from the turbo oil line
items.job: Replace turbo oil feed or return line and seals

items.t: Rough running and check engine light
items.job: Diagnose; replace PCV valve or ignition coil
items.note: Intake valve carbon cleaning costs more if needed.

items.t: Start-stop (Eco) system stops working
items.note: If the battery is fine, diagnosis of the start-stop sensors adds cost.

items.t: Navigation or infotainment screen freezes or goes blank
items.job: Update infotainment software; replace display unit if dead

items.t: Rear headliner sags and blocks the rear window
Check engine light for small EVAP leak (P0456)
items.job: Replace EVAP vent control valve O-ring

items.t: Automatic emergency braking fails or shows a fault
items.job: Diagnose and recalibrate forward radar sensor
items.note: A new radar sensor costs much more if it has failed.

items.t: Front brakes noisy
Clock resets every time the car starts
Seat leather wears through early
